custodes-guardians-of-the-throne.name: Guardians of the Throne
custodes-guardians-of-the-throne.ruleText: Fight phase: each time a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to fight, choose for its melee attacks to have either [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS].

enhancements.name: Bane of Abominations
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model's attacks targeting an enemy CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE unit get +1 to wound rolls.

enhancements.name: Emperor's Light
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model gains the melee weapon Emperor's Light [EXTRA ATTACKS]: Range Melee, A 3, WS 2+, S 5, AP -2, D 2.

enhancements.name: Castellan's Mark
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. After both players have deployed, you may redeploy up to three friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units; any of them may instead be placed into strategic reserves, ignoring the usual limit on how many units can be in strategic reserves.

enhancements.name: Eagle's Eye
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model gets +1 W. Once per battle, per army: when an attack is allocated to this model, you can use this ability; if you do, this model has a 3+ InSv (text partially obscured; duration not legible).

stratagems.name: Superhuman Focus
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of any phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit that is not readied.
EFFECT: That unit becomes readied.
RESTRICTIONS: The same unit cannot be targeted by this Stratagem more than once per battle round.

stratagems.name: Unlimited Endurance
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit finishes an advance move.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Until end of turn, your unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT], and having made that advance move does not stop the unit being eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Shield of Honour
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit.
EFFECT: Each time an enemy model engaged with your unit selects targets, unless it targets your unit with all of its attacks, that enemy model's attacks get -1 to hit rolls and -1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Prime Target
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Your unit's ranged attacks can re-roll one hit roll, one wound roll and one damage roll.

stratagems.name: In Auramite Clad
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit selects a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (other than CUSTODIAN WARDENS units) as a target.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Until that enemy unit has finished attacking, attacks targeting your unit have -1 AP.

stratagems.name: Swift as the Eagle
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit finishes a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.
TARGET: That TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.
EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

custodes-aquilan-shield.name: Aquilan Shield
custodes-aquilan-shield.ruleText:
While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (other than MONSTER/VEHICLE units) is within range of an objective, ranged attacks targeting it with a S characteristic higher than that unit's T get -1 to wound rolls.
Favoured Ka'tah — Salvus: Additional Effect: Your unit's ranged attacks have +6" R (range).

enhancements.name: Pareldor's Caducatrix
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. Once per battle, per army: at the start of any phase, this model heals D3+3 wounds.

enhancements.name: Not a Shell Wasted
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. This unit's ranged attacks have +1 A.

stratagems.name: Manoeuvre and Fire
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Making that move does not stop your unit being eligible to shoot or declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Tip of the Talon
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Your unit's ranged attacks targeting an enemy unit within 9" of your unit get +1 S.

stratagems.name: Rapid Reactions
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit finishes a fall-back move.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit that was engaged with that enemy unit at the start of the phase.
EFFECT: Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but can only select that enemy unit as a target.

custodes-dread-host.name: Dread Host
custodes-dread-host.ruleText:
Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units can re-roll charge rolls.
Favoured Ka'tah — Dacatarai: Additional Effect: Each time an enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a pile-in/consolidation move, that move is reduced by 2".

enhancements.name: Auric Exemplar
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model's melee attacks have [CLEAVE 1].

enhancements.name: Flawless Bladework
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model's melee attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: Lightning Wrath
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to make a pile-in move.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: For that pile-in move, your unit can move up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Golden Light of the Moiraides
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to make an ingress move.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Until the start of your next turn, attacks targeting your unit get -1 to hit rolls, and enemy units cannot select your unit as a target of snap shooting attacks.

stratagems.name: Preternatural Rapidity
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit finishes an advance move.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Having made that advance move does not stop your unit being eligible to declare a charge.

custodes-emissaries-imperatus.name: Emissaries Imperatus
custodes-emissaries-imperatus.ruleText:
Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units have Fights First.
Favoured Ka'tah — Conservai: Additional Effect: Until end of turn, having been selected to make an advance or fall-back move does not stop your unit being eligible to start an action.

enhancements.name: Auriferous Orb
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model gains the ranged weapon Auriferous Orb [ANTI-non-MONSTER/VEHICLE 2+, BLINDING LIGHT, DEVASTATING WOUNDS]: Range 12", A 3, BS 2+, S 1, AP 0, D 1. [BLINDING LIGHT]: In your Shooting phase, after this unit has shot, pick one enemy unit hit by its Auriferous Orb; until the start of your next turn, that unit's attacks get -1 to hit rolls.

enhancements.name: Edge of the Blade
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. If this unit made a charge move this turn, this model's attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: Bearers of His Light
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to fight.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Your unit's melee attacks can ignore all modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Slayers of Nightmares
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to fight.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Your unit's melee attacks targeting a unit whose T is higher than your unit's T get +1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Selfless Service
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent's Charge phase.
TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit within 6" of an enemy unit. A VEHICLE unit can only be selected if it is a CHARACTER or WALKER unit.
EFFECT: Your unit declares a charge. When making the charge roll, a result above 6 (after modifiers) becomes 6. When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units within 6" of your unit (end of sentence partially obscured; likely 'and within the maximum distance').

custodes-emperors-chosen.name: Emperor's Chosen
custodes-emperors-chosen.ruleText:
Each time a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to attack, its attacks can re-roll one hit roll and one wound roll.
Favoured Ka'tah — Rendax: Additional Effect: You can pick one enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE unit engaged with your unit and roll one D6: on 1-2 it suffers 1 mortal wound; on 3-5 it suffers D3 mortal wounds; on 6 it suffers 3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Radiant Mantle
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. Attacks targeting this unit get -1 to hit rolls.

enhancements.name: From the Hall of Armouries
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model's melee attacks have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

stratagems.name: Superhuman Focus
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of any phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit that is not readied.
EFFECT: That unit becomes readied.
RESTRICTIONS: The same unit cannot be targeted by this Stratagem more than once per battle round.

stratagems.name: In Auramite Clad
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit selects a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (other than CUSTODIAN WARDENS units) as a target.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Until that enemy unit has finished attacking, attacks targeting your unit have -1 AP.

stratagems.name: Impenetrable Bastion
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (other than MONSTER/VEHICLE units).
EFFECT: Pick one objective your unit controls; that objective becomes secured.

custodes-shadowkeepers.name: Shadowkeepers
custodes-shadowkeepers.ruleText:
While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (other than MONSTER/VEHICLE units) is within range of an objective, melee attacks targeting it with a S characteristic higher than that unit's T get -1 to wound rolls.
Favoured Ka'tah — Kaptaris: Additional Effect: You can pick one enemy unit engaged with your unit; it must take a battle-shock roll with -1 to that roll. The same enemy unit cannot be picked for this effect more than once per phase.

enhancements.name: Genalchemic Warding
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model has Feel No Pain 5+.

enhancements.name: Unstoppable Destroyer
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. Each time this unit is selected to make a pile-in/consolidation move, it can move up to 4", and you can choose any consolidation mode for that consolidation move, ignoring that move's Before Moving restrictions.

stratagems.name: Grim Responsibility
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit is selected to fight.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Your unit's melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: CHARACTER/MONSTER].

stratagems.name: No Escape
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit finishes a fall-back move.
TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit within 6" of that enemy unit.
EFFECT: Your unit declares a charge. When selecting charge targets, it can only select enemy units that made a fall-back move this phase and that are within the maximum distance.

stratagems.name: Indomitable Guardians
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Fight phase, after an enemy unit has fought.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit within range of an objective that is eligible to fight.
EFFECT: Your unit has Fights First and must be the next unit selected to fight (partially obscured).

custodes-solar-watch.name: Solar Watch
custodes-solar-watch.ruleText:
Each time a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit makes a fall-back move, that move does not stop the unit being eligible to charge.
Favoured Ka'tah — Calistus: Additional Effect: Your unit has +2" M.

enhancements.name: Sally Forth
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES SHIELD-CAPTAIN model only. At the start of your Charge phase, pick one friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit within 6" of this model; if that unit made an advance move this turn, that advance move does not stop it being eligible to declare a charge.

enhancements.name: Auric Eagle
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit only (not TERMINATOR units). This unit gets +1 to advance rolls and charge rolls.

stratagems.name: Inexorable
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to move.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Until end of turn, your unit can ignore modifiers to its M characteristic and to its advance rolls and charge rolls.

stratagems.name: At Spear's Length
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: That fall-back move does not stop your unit being eligible to shoot.

stratagems.name: Gravimetric Grenade
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Start of your opponent's Charge phase.
TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Pick one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit; when that enemy unit declares a charge, it gets -1 to charge rolls.

custodes-auric-champions.name: Auric Champions
custodes-auric-champions.ruleText: In your Command phase, you can pick one enemy unit; until the start of your next Command phase it is a dreadful foe unit. Attacks by friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER models targeting a dreadful foe unit get +1 to wound rolls.

enhancements.name: Shroud of the Hidden Blade
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model has Stealth and Lone Operative.

enhancements.name: Inspirational Exemplar
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. Once per battle round, per army: at the start of any phase, you can pick one friendly battle-shocked ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit within 9" of this model; that unit stops being battle-shocked.

enhancements.name: Superior Creation
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. At the end of a phase in which this model was destroyed, roll one D6: on a 2+, set it back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed, unengaged, with 3 wounds remaining.

stratagems.name: Gilded Champion
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model has used a (Once per battle, per unit) datasheet ability.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model.
EFFECT: Your model can use that (Once per battle, per unit) datasheet ability one more time, but not during the same phase.
RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem on the same ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model more than once per battle.

stratagems.name: Duty Unto Death
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit selects a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit as a target.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6 (+1 if that model is a CHARACTER). On a 3+, do not remove it; it is removed when your unit has fought or at the end of the phase, whichever happens first.

custodes-honoured-companions.name: Honoured Companions
custodes-honoured-companions.ruleText: Each time a friendly TRUSTED SENTINEL unit is within range of an objective, attacks made by that unit can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

enhancements.name: Arae-Shrike
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. Enemy units selected to make an ingress move cannot be set up within 12" of the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Celeritous Sentries
enhancements.text: TRUSTED SENTINEL unit only. Once per phase, per unit: you can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem even if that stratagem has already been used this phase. If you do, that use costs 1CP less, and it does not stop that stratagem being used on other units this phase.

stratagems.name: Emperor's Domain
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly TRUSTED SENTINEL unit is selected to make a consolidation move.
TARGET: That TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.
EFFECT: You can choose the objective consolidation mode for that consolidation move, ignoring that consolidation move's Before Moving restrictions. (In practice, your unit may move out of engagement range of enemy units, as long as it satisfies the objective consolidation mode conditions.)

stratagems.name: Avenge the Fallen
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly TRUSTED SENTINEL unit that is below starting strength is selected to fight.
TARGET: That TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.
EFFECT: Melee attacks made by your unit, other than those made by CHARACTER models, get +2 A.

stratagems.name: Swift as the Eagle
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.
TARGET: That TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.
EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6" [end of text cut off in photo].

custodes-grav-assault-force.name: Grav-Assault Force
custodes-grav-assault-force.ruleText: Friendly GRAV-ASSAULT units have a 4+ InSv against ranged attacks.

enhancements.name: Combat Deployment
enhancements.text: GRAV-ASSAULT TRANSPORT model only. When a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to make a disembark move from the bearer's unit, until the end of the turn: that unit can re-roll charge rolls; and enemy units cannot target that unit with snap shooting attacks.

enhancements.name: Anti-Gravitic Mobility
enhancements.text: GRAV-ASSAULT unit only. When this unit makes a fall-back move, that move does not stop it from being eligible to shoot.

stratagems.name: Victory Before Death
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly GRAV-ASSAULT unit that is within range of an objective is destroyed.
TARGET: That GRAV-ASSAULT unit. It can be targeted by this stratagem even though it has been destroyed.
EFFECT: Choose one objective that your unit was controlling when it was destroyed and that has no enemy units (other than AIRCRAFT units) within range of it. That objective becomes secured.

stratagems.name: Advanced Stabilisers
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAV-ASSAULT unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That GRAV-ASSAULT unit.
EFFECT: Ranged attacks made by your unit have [ASSAULT].

stratagems.name: Inevitable Annihilation
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAV-ASSAULT unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That GRAV-ASSAULT unit.
EFFECT: Your unit can ignore modifiers to its BS and to its hit rolls.

custodes-null-maiden-vigil.name: Null Maiden Vigil
custodes-null-maiden-vigil.ruleText:
When mustering your army, you can choose a friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA CHARACTER model as your WARLORD. Friendly PROSECUTOR SQUAD units have BATTLELINE. Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units gain this ability:
Creeping Dread (Aura): In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, every enemy unit within 12" of this unit that is a PSYKER unit or is below starting strength must make a battle-shock roll, subtracting 1 from that roll.

enhancements.name: Oblivion Knight
enhancements.text: ANATHEMA PSYKANA model only. Attacks made by the bearer's unit get +1 to hit rolls; or, if the unit is targeting a PSYKER or battle-shocked unit, +1 to hit rolls and +1 to wound rolls instead.

enhancements.name: Huntress' Eye
enhancements.text: ANATHEMA PSYKANA model only. In your Movement phase, you can choose one visible enemy unit within 12" of the bearer's unit; that enemy unit must make a battle-shock roll, subtracting 1 from that roll.

stratagems.name: Anathema Blademastery
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly VIGILATOR SQUAD unit is selected to fight.
TARGET: That VIGILATOR SQUAD unit.
EFFECT: Attacks made by your unit have either [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS] (your choice).

stratagems.name: Psy-chaff Volley
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PROSECUTOR SQUAD unit has shot.
TARGET: That PROSECUTOR SQUAD unit.
EFFECT: Choose one enemy unit that was hit by those attacks. Until the end of the turn that unit is prosecuted: attacks targeting a prosecuted unit get +1 AP.

stratagems.name: Purgation Sweep
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly WITCHSEEKER SQUAD unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That WITCHSEEKER SQUAD unit.
EFFECT: Your unit's [TORRENT] attacks get +1 A; or, if those attacks target a PSYKER or battle-shocked unit, +2 A instead.

custodes-lions-of-the-emperor.name: Lions of the Emperor
custodes-lions-of-the-emperor.ruleText: At the end of your opponent's Fight phase, if a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit is unengaged, you can put that unit into strategic reserves.

enhancements.name: Lightning Descent
enhancements.text: SHIELD-CAPTAIN IN ALLARUS TERMINATOR ARMOUR model only. In your first Movement phase, the bearer's unit can make an ingress move.

enhancements.name: Leonine Ferocity
enhancements.text: SHIELD-CAPTAIN IN ALLARUS TERMINATOR ARMOUR model only. Once per phase, per army: you can target the bearer's unit with the Rapid Ingress stratagem even if that stratagem has already been used this phase. If you do, that use costs 1CP less, and it does not stop that stratagem being used on other units this phase.

stratagems.name: Vigil Unending
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit.
EFFECT: Until that enemy unit has finished attacking, attacks targeting your unit get -1 D.

stratagems.name: Unleash the Lions
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit containing 2 or more models.
EFFECT: Split your unit into separate units of one model each. Each new unit has a starting strength of 1.

stratagems.name: Fury of the Emperor
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit that made an ingress move this turn is selected to declare a charge.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit.
EFFECT: Add 2 to your unit's charge rolls.

custodes-might-of-the-moritoi.name: Might of the Moritoi
custodes-might-of-the-moritoi.ruleText:
Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT units gain the following depending on their strength:
- At starting strength: +2 OC.
- Below starting strength: its attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
- Below half-strength: its attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1 and re-roll wound rolls of 1.

enhancements.name: Memento Moritoi (One per Army)
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT model only. The bearer's melee attacks get +1 A, +1 S and +1 D.

enhancements.name: Augury Uplink (One per Army)
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT model only. The bearer has Feel No Pain 5+.

stratagems.name: Honoured Interred
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit.
EFFECT: Your unit gains this ability: Honoured Interred (Aura): friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units within 6" of this unit can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: Unceasing Onslaught
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit ends an advance move.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn your unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT], and that advance move does not stop your unit being eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Unstoppable Momentum
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement or Charge phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit.
EFFECT: Your unit has MOBILE.

stratagems.name: Inescapable Justice
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In any phase, right after your Oath of Moment target is destroyed.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit on the battlefield.
EFFECT: Pick one enemy unit that is within 12" of and visible to your unit. It becomes your Oath of Moment target until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: Tactical Mastery
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your Movement phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit can shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the RAVENWING keyword, it can also shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your opponent's Shooting phase or in the Fight phase, right after an enemy unit picks its targets.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was chosen as a target for at least one of that enemy unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Until that enemy unit has resolved all of its attacks, every attack that targets your unit has its Armour Penetration characteristic worsened by 1.

stratagems.name: Lion’s Will
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In the Command phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of at least one enemy unit.
EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, models in your unit get +1 to their Objective Control characteristic. Also, until the end of the turn, if your unit does not have the DEATHWING, RAVENWING or VEHICLE keyword, add 1 to the Hit roll whenever a model in your unit makes an attack.

stratagems.name: Leonine Aggression
stratagems.text:
WHEN: At the end of your opponent's Charge phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is within 3" of at least one enemy unit, or one DEATHWING unit from your army that is within 6" of at least one enemy unit.
EFFECT: Your unit declares a charge targeting only one or more of those enemy units, and you then resolve that charge.
RESTRICTIONS: Even if the charge succeeds, your unit gets no Charge bonus this turn.

stratagems.name: Relics of the Dark Age
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your Shooting phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army that has not yet been selected to shoot this phase.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons carried by models in your unit get +2 to their Strength characteristic.

stratagems.name: In Sacrifice, Victory
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly Deathwing or Ravenwing unit that is within range of an objective marker is destroyed.
TARGET: That objective marker.
EFFECT: The objective becomes secured for you, provided it was uncontested or was controlled by the destroyed unit.

stratagems.name: Knights of Iron
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement or Charge phase, when a Ravenwing unit makes a move or declares a charge.
TARGET: That Ravenwing unit.
EFFECT: The unit gains the Mobile keyword.

custodes.name: Aegis of the Emperor
custodes.text: Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units with this ability have Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

dark-angels.name: Oath of Moment
dark-angels.text: At the start of your Command phase, pick one enemy unit as your Oath target until your next Command phase. Units with this ability re-roll hit rolls against it. (The extra +1 to wound only applies to armies without Dark Angels or other chapter units.)

orks.name: Waaagh!
orks.text: Ork units with this ability re-roll Advance rolls and can become riled up. While riled up they have a 5+ invulnerable save, their ranged attacks gain [Assault], and they can charge after Advancing. War Cry (once per battle): at the start of a Command phase, every Waaagh! unit is riled up until the end of the next turn.

orks.name: Da Boss
orks.text: If a model with this ability is your Warlord, gain 1 CP at the start of each battle round.

orks.name: Unstable Energies
orks.text: Ork Psykers have a psyker level. Each battle round a Psyker can use psychic abilities whose combined levels don't exceed its psyker level.

tyranids.name: Synapse
tyranids.text: Tyranids within 6" of a friendly Synapse model are in Synapse Range. While in range, they take Battle-shock tests on 3D6 and get +1 Strength on melee attacks.

tyranids.name: Shadow in the Warp
tyranids.text: Once per battle, in either Command phase, if a unit with this ability is on the battlefield: every enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test, at -1 if within 6" of one of your Synapse units.
